identity: bilattice-articulation-model-belief-orienting-operation
name: Bilattice Articulation Model Belief Orienting Operation
keywords: [bilattice, articulation, model, belief, orienting, operation]
---

BAMBOO composes an articulated bilattice model into an operation that orients a belief state while retaining the evidence needed to inspect its choice. The compound is an engineering contract for that composition, not a definition of its constituent concepts.
